title: A Clear, Modern Space for Machine Knitters
author: Sue Jalowiec
excerpt: A fresh, modern start for machine knitters. Knit by Machine is taking shape one tool, one answer, and one small step at a time - and you’re invited to be part of the journey.
body:
Welcome to Knit by Machine

A fresh, modern home for machine knitters who want clarity, confidence, and practical guidance - without clutter or overwhelm.

Knit by Machine is built for knitters who want answers quickly, appreciate clean design, and enjoy tools that make knitting easier and more satisfying. Everything here is shaped around what helps you succeed at your machine.

What You’ll Find Here

Knit by Machine is organized around three focused areas:

Ask ’n Answer (ANA)
Fast, straightforward answers to the questions that stop you mid-project. No digging through forums or guessing - just clear explanations so you can keep moving.

Skill & Technique Guides
Step-by-step walkthroughs for essential skills, troubleshooting, shaping, and finishing.

Interactive Wizards
Smart calculators, planners, and practice tools that handle the math and technical details. You focus on knitting - the tools take care of the rest.

What’s Next

Answers, guides, and tools are shaped by real questions and real knitting challenges. If something would make your knitting easier, you’re in the right place.

Ready to Explore?

Start with the Ask ’n Answer Help Hub for quick help.

Happy knitting,
- Sue
qaSection:
Questions & Answers

What is Knit by Machine?

Knit by Machine is a fresh, modern home for machine knitters. It offers clarity, confidence, and practical guidance without clutter or overwhelm—so you can get answers quickly and enjoy using your knitting machine.

Who is Knit by Machine for?

Knit by Machine is for any machine knitter—beginner, returner, or experienced— who wants clean design, quick answers, and tools that make knitting easier and more fun.

What will I find here?

Three main areas: Ask ’n Answer (ANA) for fast, straightforward answers; Skill & Technique Guides for step-by-step help; and Interactive Wizards that handle the math so you can focus on knitting.

What are Interactive Wizards?

Smart calculators, pattern planners, and practice tools that take care of the numbers and technical details. You can spend more time knitting and less time crunching math.

How often is new content added?

New answers and resources are developed based on real questions and real knitting challenges. Feedback helps shape what comes next.
